newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,517 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,517 contracts.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totalled 1,517 contracts compared with 1,928 overnight Monday, according to the CBOT.
There were 195 wheat, 607 corn, 546 soybean, 167 soymeal, and two soyoil contracts traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was 3-1/2 cent per bushel to 2-1/4 cent lower, corn was 1-3/4 cent to 1/2 cent lower and soybeans were one cent lower to 2-3/4 cents higher.
